title: "RFC 023: Resting State Automation Test"
subtitle: "Serve Workspace Validation and Execution on Current Test Data"
date: 2026-01-19
---

## Executive Summary

A resting state automated analysis was configured and executed using the existing serve workspace and the current test dataset. The serve configuration was updated to a single-route automations model, validated, deployed, and run for one cycle with a fresh queue. Two `.set` files were processed successfully, producing exports, run reports, and updated automation workspace artifacts.

## Workspace and Data Context

| Item | Path |
|---|---|
| Serve workspace | `/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace` |
| Ingestion root | `/Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch` |
| Task file | `/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace/BiotrialResting1020.py` |
| Automation root | `/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace/automations` |
| Queue file | `/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace/queue-resting.json` |

: Table 1. Paths used for the resting state automation test.

## Serve Configuration

The serve test YAML was updated to a single-route `automations` configuration with explicit defaults and `.set` file globbing.

```yaml
mode: test
automation_mode: true
runtime: runtimes/test
runtime_package: /Volumes/owcssd/github/autocleaneeg_pipeline
defaults:
  automation_root: automations
  workspace_name: taskfile-montage-version
  file_globs:
    - "*.set"
  sentinel_ext: ".ready"
  recursive: true
automations:
  - taskfile: /Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace/BiotrialResting1020.py
    montage: standard_1020
    ingestion_folders:
      - /Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch
```

## Execution Steps

| Step | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Validate config | `uv run python -m autoclean.cli serve validate --mode test --path /Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace` | Success |
| Deploy config | `uv run python -m autoclean.cli serve deploy --mode test --path /Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace` | Success |
| Run ingestion | `uv run python -m autoclean.cli serve run --mode test --path /Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace --queue-path /Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/serve-workspace/queue-resting.json --max-cycles 1 --idle-limit 1 --no-watch` | Success |

: Table 2. Commands executed for the automation test.

Exports produced for both `.set` files include `201001_D1BL_EC_comp_epo.set` and `201001_D1BL_EO_comp_epo.set`, along with per-file processing logs in the exports directory. Run reports include per-file PDF summaries and JSON metadata files in the run reports directory.

## Observations

- The CLI emitted extra environment lines (Qt backend and unrelated workspace/task info) during validation and deployment; these appear to be ambient runtime output rather than serve-specific errors.
- Expected warnings were observed for EOG channel positions, BrainVision conversion, empty participants TSV initialization, and head radius estimation; the run completed successfully despite these warnings.

## Appendix A: Validation Notes

The test used the existing `runtimes/test` environment under the serve workspace to avoid re-installing runtime dependencies during setup.
